admin_users_display_name_shape.name: admin_users_display_name_shape
admin_users_display_name_shape.value: "admin_users"."display_name" is null or (char_length("admin_users"."display_name") between 1 and 80 and "admin_users"."display_name" = btrim("admin_users"."display_name"))

people_relevance_scores_range.name: people_relevance_scores_range
people_relevance_scores_range.value: ("people"."ai_relevance_score" is null or "people"."ai_relevance_score" between 0 and 10) and ("people"."relevance_score" is null or "people"."relevance_score" between 0 and 10)

people_other_socials_length.name: people_other_socials_length
people_other_socials_length.value: "people"."other_socials" is null or length("people"."other_socials") between 1 and 2048

people_contact_dates_order.name: people_contact_dates_order
people_contact_dates_order.value: "people"."first_contact_on" is null or "people"."last_contact_on" is null or "people"."first_contact_on" <= "people"."last_contact_on"

people_wise_recipient_id_length.name: people_wise_recipient_id_length
people_wise_recipient_id_length.value: "people"."wise_recipient_id" is null or length("people"."wise_recipient_id") between 1 and 100

people_contact_lengths.name: people_contact_lengths
people_contact_lengths.value:
coalesce(length("people"."email"), 0) <= 320 and coalesce(length("people"."phone"), 0) <= 64
        and coalesce(length("people"."website"), 0) <= 2048 and coalesce(length("people"."linkedin"), 0) <= 2048
        and coalesce(length("people"."x"), 0) <= 2048 and coalesce(length("people"."other_contact"), 0) <= 500

treasury_entries_fee_pending_idx.name: treasury_entries_fee_pending_idx
treasury_entries_fee_pending_idx.where: "treasury_entries"."source" = 'stripe' and "treasury_entries"."fee_amount" is null and "treasury_entries"."settlement_currency" is null

treasury_entries_gross_sign.name: treasury_entries_gross_sign
treasury_entries_gross_sign.value: ("treasury_entries"."entry_type" = 'donation' and "treasury_entries"."gross_amount" > 0) or ("treasury_entries"."entry_type" in ('expense', 'refund') and "treasury_entries"."gross_amount" < 0) or ("treasury_entries"."entry_type" = 'dispute' and "treasury_entries"."gross_amount" <> 0)

treasury_entries_settlement_together.name: treasury_entries_settlement_together
treasury_entries_settlement_together.value:
("treasury_entries"."settlement_currency" is null and "treasury_entries"."settlement_gross_amount" is null and "treasury_entries"."settlement_fee_amount" is null and "treasury_entries"."settlement_net_amount" is null and "treasury_entries"."exchange_rate" is null)
        or ("treasury_entries"."settlement_currency" is not null and "treasury_entries"."settlement_gross_amount" is not null and "treasury_entries"."settlement_fee_amount" is not null and "treasury_entries"."settlement_net_amount" is not null and "treasury_entries"."exchange_rate" is not null
            and "treasury_entries"."settlement_currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$' and "treasury_entries"."settlement_currency" <> "treasury_entries"."currency" and ("treasury_entries"."settlement_fee_amount" >= 0 or "treasury_entries"."entry_type" = 'dispute')
            and "treasury_entries"."settlement_net_amount" = "treasury_entries"."settlement_gross_amount" - "treasury_entries"."settlement_fee_amount" and "treasury_entries"."exchange_rate" > 0)

treasury_entries_recipient_rules.name: treasury_entries_recipient_rules
treasury_entries_recipient_rules.value:
("treasury_entries"."entry_type" = 'expense' or ("treasury_entries"."recipient_person_id" is null and "treasury_entries"."recipient_organization_id" is null))
        and not ("treasury_entries"."recipient_person_id" is not null and "treasury_entries"."recipient_organization_id" is not null)
        and ("treasury_entries"."entry_type" <> 'expense' or "treasury_entries"."review_status_key" not in ('qualified', 'not_required')
             or ("treasury_entries"."recipient_person_id" is null) <> ("treasury_entries"."recipient_organization_id" is null))
